QuestInfo.name: Omen Piece
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Arin who has something to give to you.
QuestInfo.1: Arin gave you all the Omen Pieces she collected so far. Bring them to the White Mage.\r\n#b(The White Mage's room is on the right side of the lobby.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave the Omen Pieces to the White Mage and had a short but deep conversation with him.

0.0: These are all the #bOmen Pieces#k that I collected so far. Now I don't know for sure, but I hear that magicians experiment with this kind of stuff. Maybe they can figure out the #ridentity of the Omens#k.

yes.0: Give these to the White Mage. He's pretty powerful... I'm sure he can get rid of all those Omens in a flash, right? Am I right?\r\n#b(Go to the White Mage's room on the right side of the lobby.)#k

no.0: Hey, it's not like I'm ordering you around. All you have to do is bring them to him.

1.0: What? You're looking for the master? I told you, don't go bother him unless it's very important! VERY important!\r\n

yes.0: Ahem... Please be more careful next time. The master is on the roof of the temple.\r\n#b(Jeez, how grumpy... Go to the rooftop.)#k

npc.0: Give these to the White Mage. He's pretty powerful... I'm sure he can get rid of all those Omens in a flash, right? Am I right?\r\n#b(Go to the White Mage's room on the right side of the lobby.)#k

quest.0: Yes?\r\n#b(You must get the Omen Pieces from Arin.)#k

yes.0: Don't be so clumsy! Don't you know what I went through to collect them?
